title: 777 Charlie Director Kiranraj K Lines Up Next Film With Dhruva Sarja
excerpt: The National Award-winning Kannada filmmaker, known for the heartwarming 777 Charlie, is preparing a new project with action star Dhruva Sarja as he expands his cinematic ambitions.
body:
• Kiranraj K's next film will star Kannada action star Dhruva Sarja, with a rough script in place and filming expected to begin within months
  • 777 Charlie (2022), Kiranraj's directorial debut, grossed over ₹105 crore and won the National Film Award for Best Kannada Film
  • The filmmaker rose from working as a waiter and security guard to directing one of Kannada cinema's biggest crossover hits

From Paper Boy to National Award Winner

Kiranraj K, the self-taught filmmaker behind one of Indian cinema's most beloved recent films, is returning to the director's chair. His next project will pair him with Kannada action star Dhruva Sarja, according to The Hollywood Reporter India.

A rough script is in place, and filming is expected to begin once Sarja finishes his current project, the action film Criminal, alongside Rachita Ram. "A rough script is in place, and the full script will be finalised soon. The film will go on floors in the next three to four months," a source close to the production told THR India.

The pairing represents a shift for Kiranraj, whose debut feature 777 Charlie was an intimate emotional drama centered on a lonely factory worker and a Labrador retriever. Sarja, known for intense action roles, was last seen in 2024's Martin and is awaiting the release of KD: The Devil.

The 777 Charlie Phenomenon

Released in June 2022 across five languages — Kannada, Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, and Hindi — 777 Charlie became a pan-Indian phenomenon. The film, produced by Rakshit Shetty's Paramvah Studios, grossed over ₹105 crore during its theatrical run and went on to win the National Film Award for Best Kannada Film.

The story of Dharma, an unapproachable factory worker whose life is transformed by an enthusiastic stray dog named Charlie, struck a chord across linguistic boundaries. Actor Prithviraj Sukumaran acquired the film for its Malayalam release, Karthik Subbaraj distributed the Tamil version, and Rana Daggubati handled the Telugu release.

"I have seen every kind of emotion up close at a very young age. That's why I was able to write scenes that would allow the audience to empathise with my characters."

— Kiranraj K, Director

A Remarkable Origin Story

Kiranraj's path to filmmaking is one of Indian cinema's most compelling underdog stories. Born in Kasargod, Kerala, he began working as a paper boy at age 8. Family constraints forced him to abandon formal education after class 10. He worked as a waiter, a bar server, and a security guard before finding his way into cinema.

"Family constraints cut my dreams of attending college, and I cannot describe that pain in words. I did face a lot of harassment, and there was never a day when I didn't cry myself to sleep," Kiranraj told Cinema Express in 2022.

His break came when he joined Rishab Shetty's team as an assistant director on Ricky (2016) and later worked with Rakshit Shetty on the hit Kirik Party (2016). It was during this period that he developed the story of 777 Charlie, inspired by watching a mother dog play with her puppies.

Shetty himself has spoken about the unique emotional depth Kiranraj brings. "Only a person who has had such life experiences can bring emotions like the one you see in 777 Charlie onscreen. I am a writer and director, but I could never write or direct a film like 777 Charlie," Shetty said in an interview with OTTplay.

What's Ahead

While the Dhruva Sarja collaboration is confirmed, IMDb also lists an untitled Kiranraj project in pre-production. With 777 Charlie having proven his ability to connect with audiences across India, the filmmaker's next moves are being closely watched. The combination of Kiranraj's emotional storytelling with Sarja's mass appeal could produce something that bridges art-house sensibility and commercial filmmaking in Kannada cinema.
